title: "Evaluation"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
s <- jsonlite::fromJSON("results/summary.json")
```

The numbers on this page are written by `R/04_evaluation.R` to `results/summary.json`. The claims data is proprietary and not in the repository, so the report renders from that summary file and from the figures produced by `R/05_figures.R`.

## The two detectors disagree

Spearman rank correlation between AIDA and Isolation Forest scores is `r s$spearman_rho`, and `r s$top100_overlap` claim(s) appear in both top-100 lists.

![](figures/score_comparison.png)

## AIDA against the rule engine

AUC against the held-out rules is `r s$auc_vs_rules`. `r s$top100_no_rule` of AIDA's top 100 claims fired no rule at all, which is the point: the two systems surface different claims.

## What drives the scores

TIX attributes `r round(100 * s$tix_share_onehot)`% of the score mass to one-hot categoricals, `r round(100 * s$tix_share_missing)`% to missingness flags and `r round(100 * s$tix_share_numeric)`% to numeric features.

![](figures/tix_attribution.png)
